issues.description: Inconsistent naming of the HTTP endpoint that returns all persons: the template and the problem statement use the path '/persons' (e.g. tests and API documentation expect '/persons'), but the solution's PersonResource exposes the GET endpoint at '/people'. This discrepancy can confuse students about the correct endpoint to implement/use and may cause test or integration mismatches.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the endpoint path consistent across all artifacts. Prefer using '/persons' (as used in the problem statement and tests) by changing the solution's @GetMapping("people") to @GetMapping("persons"). Alternatively, update the problem statement and tests to use '/people'—but ensure all references (tests, docs, and template code) match the chosen path.
